buildings.name: Academy
buildings.description: The Academy allows a player to Research Technology to increase their Turf's Might. Research allows players to unlock advanced military troops, traps, and other defenses. Research can also help reduce construction time and can allow more resource to be gathered at a faster pace. The Academy is a permanent building, meaning that once it has been built in a player's Turf, it cannot be demolished. Upgrade the Academy to reduce research time. Some technologies also require a higher Academy level. See the Research page to view all available Research trees in the Academy.

buildings.name: Castle
buildings.description: The Castle is one of the most important buildings in a player's Turf. Upgrading it unlocks other Construction|buildings and new features, and increases the might of the player, among other benefits. The Castle is a fixed building, meaning its location is set from the start of the game and cannot be changed by the player. When a player clicks their Castle, they can view statistics about their castle wall, troops, traps, and Resource. Castle Skins can be bought from the game's store to change its appearance and to grant the player buffs such as increased resource production or troop stats. This also affects its appearance in the Kingdom Map. It is important to note: *A player that has a level 5 or higher Castle can no longer use a Novice Relocator. *Having a level 10 or higher Castle allows a player's leader to be captured by other player's Prison. *Having a level 17 or higher Castle allows a player's leader to be executed if captured by other player's Altar. *Castle level directly influences some required points in solo and hell events, with higher castle levels requiring orders of magnitude more points than lower levels. This is especially relevant when looking for Watcher medals. *Number of rewarded Watcher medals depends on castle level. 1 medal from level 3 to 21, 2 medals from level 22 to 24, and 3 medals at castle level 25. *Chaos Dragon medals are available on Hell events only after the castle reaches level 25. *Daily Quest rewards are related to castle level. Most notably Bravehearts stops being offered at castle level 18, and Gryphon chests stop being offered at castle level 25

buildings.name: Embassy
buildings.description: The Embassy allows the player to hold Allied Troops or deploy them to a Guild mate, which will assist the main army during an invasion. The Embassy is a permanent building, meaning that once it has been built in a player's Turf, it cannot be demolished. Upgrade to increase the amount of Allied Troops it can hold.

buildings.name: Trading Post
buildings.description: The Trading Post allows Guild members to Supply resource to each other. The Trading Post is a permanent building, meaning that once it has been built in a player's Turf, it cannot be demolished. Upgrade the Trading Post to increase the amount of resource that can be sent and decrease the supply tax. At level 25, the Trading Post boosts Supply Troops Travel Speed by 100%. To send resource through the Trading Post, tap the Supply button and find the guild member on the list.

buildings.name: Vault
buildings.description: The Vault is a building that protects resource from enemy attacks. The Vault is a fixed building, meaning its location is set in the Turf from the start of the game and cannot be changed by the player. Depending on the number of maximum resource protected, anything more can be looted by enemies when they attack the turf. It can only protect food, wood, stone and ore, unlocking gold protection at level 25. When a player uses a Migration Scroll, the player can only migrate with the number of resource protected by their vault and the rest is lost. During migration, the gold is protected by vault (same amount as the other resource) even if not at level 25. Upgrading the Vault will increase the number of resource protected by the vault. At Level 25, gold protection is unlocked.

buildings.name: Watchtower
buildings.description: The Watchtower detects troops approaching the player's turf or camps. The Watchtower is a fixed building, meaning its location is set from the start of the game and cannot be demolished by the player. A border will be created around the game screen depending on what sort of troops are approaching. *A red border can be seen when enemy troops or scouts are approaching a turf/camp *A green border when supply troops are approaching the turf *A blue border when allied troops or garrisons are approaching the turf. Upgrading the Watchtower will unlock new abilities for the watchtower. At Level 25, it gives the player a Fortify button which allows them to activate defense boosts and lower the enemy's power as well as giving the enemy a reduced troop ATK of 10%. When defending against a Dark Army from Bait and Conquer Adventure Quests, all enemy army info will be displayed as if the player has upgraded the Watchtower to level 23, regardless of the player's current Watchtower level.

buildings.name: Workshop
buildings.description: The Workshop is one of the main buildings required to progress in Lords Mobile. In the Workshop, Materials can be used to forge or upgrade Equipment, which provides various boosts when equipped to the Leader. The Workshop is a permanent building, meaning that once it has been built in a player's Turf, it cannot be moved or demolished. __NOTOC__

buildings.name: Barrack
buildings.description: The Barracks are buildings that allows the player to train and dismiss soldiers. The player may have as many Barracks as they wish, as long as the total number of Barracks, Infirmary and Manor does not exceed 17. Multiple barracks will increase barracks capacity. Either infantry, ranged, cavalry, or siege engine troop types can be trained at once, of up to 5 different tiers (see Troop). Higher-tier troops must first be researched to train them. Upgrading the Barracks will increase the number of soldiers that can be trained at once. At Level 6, the turf will receive a bonus Army DEF increase of 1%, 2% at Level 12, 3% at Level 18, 4% at Level 24 and 10% at Level 25.

buildings.name: Castle Wall
buildings.description: The Castle Wall surrounds the Castle and is the first line of defense for preventing enemy troops from entering the Turf. The Castle Wall is a fixed building, meaning its location is set from the start of the game and cannot be changed by the player. A damaged Castle Wall will regenerate over time at a base rate of 1 HP every 4 seconds, which can be increased with the Castle Wall Repair Speed stat boost. When the Castle Wall's Health Points (HP) reach 0, traps become useless and the invading army will begin attacking any troops within the turf. When the player's turf has been successfully invaded, the Castle Wall will be on fire for 20 minutes after the attack; during this time the wall will stop healing itself. The fire can be extinguished immediately using Gravel. Up to 5 Heroes and Familiars (if Familiar Battle Slots are unlocked) can be stationed in the Castle Wall. Deployed heroes and familiars will defend the turf and be involved in defense when an invading player attacks. Traps can be built in the Castle Wall, and as long as Wall HP remains above 0, will attack invading troops. Traps can also be repaired in the Castle Wall, if Trap Retrieval research is unlocked. Upgrading the Castle Wall will increase the wall's HP and maximum trap capacity. At Level 25, the turf will receive a bonus Trap ATK increase of 10%. The Castle Wall can be further upgraded with the Defense and Upgrade Defenses Research trees. The Mole Shaman Familiar's Rapid Repair skill can instantly repair up to 50% of a damaged Wall's health.

buildings.name: Infirmary
buildings.description: The Infirmary is a building which holds and heals injured defenders. The player may have as many Infirmaries as they wish, as long as the total number of Barrack, Infirmary and Manor does not exceed 17.

buildings.name: Manor
buildings.description: The Manor is a building that produces Gold. The player may have as many Manors as they wish, as long as the total number of Barrack, Infirmary and Manor does not exceed 17. Upgrading the Manor will increase its gold production rate, maximum gold storage and Barracks' training speed. If the Manor's storage is full, production will stop. At Level 25, the turf will receive a bonus Army ATK increase of 2%.

buildings.name: Farm
buildings.description: The Farm is a Resource Building that produces Food. The player may have as many Farms as they wish, as long as the total number of Farm, Lumber Mill, Mine and Quarry does not exceed 18. Upgrading a Farm will increase its Food Production rate and the maximum Food Storage. If a player's Total Food Storage is full, all production will stop. All Troops have an hourly Food upkeep, meaning that they consume a certain amount of food from the Total Food Storage, which is deleted every second. If players have a higher Upkeep than Food Production, no food will be produced, and the Food icon on the left side of the screen will display a flashing red 0. This is also called being 'Food Negative', and it has zero consequences for players Troops, or Turf. Accounts that produce enough Food to cover the hourly Upkeep, are known as 'Food Positive'. Upkeep can be reduced with the Reduce Upkeep Turf boost, and with certain Equipment.

buildings.name: Lumber Mill
buildings.description: The Lumber Mill is a building that produces Timber. The player may have as many Lumber Mills as they wish, as long as the total number of Farm, Lumber Mill, Mine and Quarry does not exceed 18. Upgrading the Lumber Mill will increase its production rate and maximum storage. If the Lumber Mill's storage is full, production will stop.

buildings.name: Lunar Foundry
buildings.description: The Lunar Foundry is a late-game resource building that produces Lunite, which is used to craft Luminous Gears to upgrade Tier 4 Troops to Tier 5 (see also Barrack). This building is unlocked through the Lunar Foundry Research in the Academy. The building is located on a small cliff to the west of the Watchtower. Upon tapping the tile, if the player has not unlocked the Lunar Foundry yet, it will simply display the following message: Lunite production stops when storage is full. Upgrade the building and research technology in the Gear tree to increase efficiency.

buildings.name: Mana Lode
buildings.description: The Mana Lode is a building that produces Mana Ore. It lets player refine Mana Ore into Mana Crystals and Manasteel. Upgrading the Mana Lode will increase its Mana Ore production rate and maximum Mana Ore storage. If the Mana Lode's storage is full, production will stop.

buildings.name: Mine
buildings.description: The Mines are buildings that produces Ore. The player may have as many Mines as they wish, as long as the total number of Farm, Lumber Mill, Mine and Quarry does not exceed 18. Upgrading the Mine will increase its production rate and maximum storage. If the Mine's storage is full, production will stop.

buildings.name: Quarry
buildings.description: The Quarry is a building that produces Stone. The player may have as many Quarries as they wish, as long as the total number of Farm, Lumber Mill, Mine and Quarry does not exceed 18. Upgrading the Quarry will increase its production rate and maximum storage. If the Quarry's storage is full, production will stop.

buildings.name: Altar
buildings.description: The Altar is a building that gives boost after executing leaders that have been captured in a Prison, to give the turf temporary boosts. It is unlocked after the player completes Kingdom Chapter 8-9: Ancient Altar. Only one Altar may be built. The Altar is a permanent building, meaning that once it has been built in a player's Turf, it cannot be demolished. The player can execute Leaders belonging to Castles of Level 17 or higher. To execute a leader, the player will need to wait for the "time before execution", which can be found in the Prison. This will depend on the Prison level and the captured leader's level. The Strix Familiar's Quick Fix skill, when maxed, can reduce this wait by an additional 6 hours. Once the execution time is reached, the player will then need to press Execute within a limited time, in order to activate the Altar. For executing any level leader, the player will receive a boost to Army ATK, Army DEF, Army HP, and Travel Speed. The higher the level of the Altar, the better the boosts (see the table below). Altar boosts will last for 24 hours. For each additional leader executed, the time will extend by another 24 hours. The Devotion research and Magus Familiar's Sacrificial Offering skill can extend the Altar boost duration by up to 6 hours each, for a total duration of 36 hours per executed leader. Soul Crystals are required to build and upgrade the Altar. There are 25 levels to upgrade, and the total of 20,000 are required to fully upgrade an Altar.

buildings.name: Battle Hall
buildings.description: The Battle Hall lets players start or join Rallies. The rally leader's Battle Hall level determines the maximum number of Soldiers in the Rally. Every troop involved in the Rally uses the stats of the rally leader, and not the stats of the player who owns the troops. Players can also edit their Battalions in the Battle Hall. War Tomes are required to upgrade the Battle Hall. There are 25 levels to upgrade, and the total of 20,000 are required to fully upgrade a Battle Hall. The Battle Hall is a permanent building, meaning that once it has been built in a player's Turf, it cannot be demolished. {|class="article-table" !Battle Hall Tab 1 !Battle Hall Tab 2 !Battle Hall Tab 3 |- |Join the Rally |Assist Your Ally |Edit Battalion |}

buildings.name: Mana Chamber
buildings.description: The Mana Chamber is a special building used for enhancing the basic attributes of the troop types. The Mana Chamber can be found inbuilt. Upgrading the Mana Chamber will let the player enhance more basic attributes and increase Mana lvl of troops.

buildings.name: Prison
buildings.description: The Prison allows a player to capture enemy Leaders with Level 10+ Castles. Execution wait times depends on the Leader Level; upgrade the building to reduce wait time. The Strix familiar's Quick Fix skill can reduce the wait time by up to an additional 6 hours. Once the wait time is over, the prisoner must be executed within 6 hours, or it will escape. Steel Cuffs are needed to build and upgrade the Prison. There are 25 levels to upgrade, and the total of 20,000 are required to fully upgrade a Prison. Lv. 25 grants Capture boost. The Prison is a permanent building, meaning that once it has been built in a player's Turf, it cannot be demolished.

buildings.name: Treasure Trove
buildings.description: The Treasure Trove unlocks when players complete Kingdom Chapter 8-1 and have reached Castle Level 15. There are only 9 levels to upgrade. In the Treasure Trove players can make Gem deposits, which will gain interest and earn the player more Gems. The minimum deposit amount is set at 10,000 Gems, and the deposit can be made for either 7, 14 or 30 days. Crystal Pickaxes are needed to build and upgrade the Treasure Trove. There are 9 levels to upgrade, and the total of 5,000 are required to fully upgrade a Treasure Trove. With the Max Deposit I Research players can add up to 10,000 to the max deposit. This amount can be increased by another 5,000 with the Max Deposit II Research. The max deposit can also be increased by another 2,000 to 10,000 Gems through the Capitalist skill of the Hoarder Familiar, the amount depending on the skill level of the Familiar.

buildings.name: Gym
buildings.description: The Gym is where players can train their Familiars to gain EXP to increase their Familiar Level. The player may have as many Gyms as they wish, as long as the total number of Gym, Mystic Spire and Spring does not exceed 8. Elder Familiars at max level can also be trained to gain Skill EXP. Familiars can no longer be trained when their Familiar Level and Skill Levels are all maxed. Each Gym built will give 1 additional training slot.

buildings.name: Monsterhold
buildings.description: The Monsterhold is where players can manage their Familiars. The central Familiar building, the Monsterhold is where Pacts are opened to summon and enhance Familiars, and where Familiar skills can be upgraded. Players can also shatter Runes here, and access their Pact Case. The Monsterhold is a fixed building, meaning its location is set when the player clears Skirmish 8 and cannot be changed.

buildings.name: Mystic Spire
buildings.description: The Mystic Spire is where Pacts and Skillstones can be merged by combining resources and Anima. The player may have as many Mystic Spires as they wish, as long as the total number of Gym, Mystic Spire and Spring does not exceed 8. The Skillstone section of the Mystic Spire will only be available once a Familiar that requires Skillstones reaches Elder Stage.

buildings.name: Spring
buildings.description: The Spring produces Anima and increases the Merging speed of Pacts. The player may have as many Mystic Springs as they wish, as long as the total number of Gym, Mystic Spire and Spring does not exceed 8. At level 25, the Spring also increases the Merging speed of Skillstones by 3%.
